songs.prompt: Energetic battle music for a cute card battle game at night in a magical sweets shop. Bright square-wave synth lead, brass stabs, driving strings, punchy bass, xylophone accents, energetic drums. A minor, 150 BPM, steady tempo. Exciting and tense but still cute and fun, not scary. Loopable game BGM with consistent energy, no fade-out. Instrumental only, no vocals.

Whimsical orchestral battle music for a cute fantasy card game set at night. Staccato strings, pizzicato, playful woodwinds, bold brass, timpani, glockenspiel and celesta sparkles. D minor, 140 BPM, steady tempo. Magical, adventurous, a little mischievous, never dark. Loopable game BGM with consistent energy, no fade-out. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir.

Upbeat electronic pop battle music for a cute card game at a night festival. Plucky synths, sparkling arpeggios, bouncy synth bass, claps and a four-on-the-floor kick, bright bell lead. E minor, 145 BPM, steady tempo. Exciting, colorful and fun. Loopable game BGM with consistent energy, no fade-out. Instrumental only, no vocals, no vocal chops.
